complexity.instructions: Rate the project the docs describe.

criteria.0: a snippet or a single file: no architecture, dependencies or constraints to speak of
criteria.1: a small script or one-off tool
criteria.2: a small single-purpose utility or library of a few files
criteria.3: a small application with a handful of modules and common dependencies
criteria.4: a moderate codebase: several packages, a build and test setup, conventions to follow
criteria.5: a medium application with several components, integrations and documented conventions
criteria.6: a larger codebase with a layered architecture, many dependencies and cross-cutting rules
criteria.7: a multi-service or multi-platform system with integration points and compatibility constraints
criteria.8: a large production system with strict invariants and performance, security or concurrency constraints
criteria.9: a large enterprise system: many modules and teams, legacy and compliance constraints, a wide blast radius
criteria.10: a very large, critical system where almost any change needs deep cross-system understanding

complexity_evidence.instructions: Does the text describe the project?

criteria.true: the text describes the project's size, architecture, dependencies or constraints
criteria.false: the text is only style rules, workflow instructions or other content that says nothing about the project itself
